headline: Earnings surge year over year on a low prior-year base
summary_short: Magellan Aerospace reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of C$0.40, up 342.1% y/y from C$0.09.
summary_long: EPS of C$0.40 rose 342.1% year-over-year from a C$0.09 base and 37.2% sequentially from C$0.29 in the prior quarter. The year-over-year percentage move is inflated by the low prior-year base. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Year-over-year growth is off a low prior-year base (C$0.09), which inflates the percentage move.
